title: SensorView Software Intro
summary: What SensorView does in an nLight system: discovery, grouping, profiles/schedules, and commissioning.

blocks.content: SensorView is the management software for nLight networked systems. It discovers devices, organizes them into groups, and configures behavior such as timeouts, dimming levels, and schedules.
Think of SensorView as the 'brain' for configuration and monitoring — the devices enforce control locally, SensorView orchestrates them.
Devices are organized into groups that behave together. Profiles define settings (levels, timeouts), and schedules apply time-based behavior such as after-hours reduction.
Get grouping right first — schedules and profiles are far easier to manage when the group structure mirrors how spaces are used.
A typical flow: discover devices, verify each responds, assign to groups, apply profiles/schedules, then validate operation and document the configuration.
Always validate after configuration — confirm sensors, dimming, and schedules behave as the sequence of operation requires before leaving site.
